paragraphs: Rav Papa, son of Rav Yosef.
Mentioned in Bava Metzia 113b: he explained [a teaching] before Rav Yosef.[^1]

notes.text: תרגם is read as explained or interpreted in the scholastic setting; “[a teaching]” supplies the understood object without asserting a professional translator’s role. Rav Papa is the understood subject. קיג: gives Bava Metzia 113b under the colon convention, without independent named-edition verification. All three Rav titles are full in the source.
